title: Operations & Process Improvement: Platform Engineering & Reviews — D5
purpose: Shows what changes at 10x load and where operational cost moves.
routing_rationale: Platform engineering treats developer experience as a product; Golden Paths provide self-service templates that embed enterprise security, networking, and observability by default.

nodes.label: Backstage Service Catalog
nodes.detail: Developer chooses 'Secure Event-Driven Go Microservice' from catalog.

nodes.label: Service Sizing Form
nodes.detail: Captures business unit, cost center, QPS expectations, and environment tier.

nodes.label: Cloud Workflows Orchestrator
nodes.detail: Coordinates GCP Project creation, IAM role bindings, and GitHub repository creation.

nodes.label: New GCP Project (Shared VPC)
nodes.detail: Pre-configured with org policies, Shared VPC attachment, and CMEK encryption keys.

nodes.label: Isolated GKE Namespace
nodes.detail: Provisioned with pre-wired CI/CD deployment service account and Prometheus monitoring.

steps.title: Self-Service Intake
steps.action: Developer submits template form; platform validates metadata and cost center.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates ticket-based delays while maintaining financial accountability.

steps.title: Automated Platform Vending
steps.action: Cloud Workflows provisions project, binds IAM roles, and attaches Shared VPC in under 3 minutes.
steps.why_traversal: Delivers secure-by-default infrastructure without developer cognitive burden.

scenarios.label: Project Quota Exhaustion Halts Vending
scenarios.root_cause: Organization reached folder quota ceiling of 100 projects.
scenarios.diverted_path: Cloud Workflows catches error; dispatches automated quota increase request.
scenarios.recovery: Implement automated quota buffer monitoring alert at 80% project quota utilization.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
